dataset: fma_all: merged fire management areas (all agencies + Parks Canada)
publisher: Derived (this project) from agency layers listed below
record_count: 146 rows (99 agency/remainder/whole-province rows + 47 Parks Canada rows)
validation_notes: Columns: fma_id, agency, area_name, province, area_level, boundary_status, source, area_km2_equal_area. Agency polygons clipped to StatCan 2021 province polygons; non-Parks rows per province sum to the province polygon area (max diff 0.03% BC). Parks Canada rows deliberately overlap provincial rows. Sub-provincial boundaries present for BC (6 fire centres), AB (10 forest areas + remainder outside Forest Protection Area 251,938 km2), SK (12 SPSA protection areas + 4,034 km2 slivers), ON (14 fire mgmt HQ areas + remainder 78,578 km2 = far south / Far North outside HQ polygons), NT (5 regions), YT (13 districts), NL (26 forest mgmt districts, not fire-specific). WHOLE-PROVINCE ONLY (no public boundary found): MB, QC (SOPFEU zones), NB, NS, PE, NU. All geometries valid.

dataset: StatCan 2021 provinces and territories, cartographic boundary file (lpr_000b21a_e equivalent)
source_url: https://geo.statcan.gc.ca/geo_wa/rest/services/2021/Cartographic_boundary_files/MapServer/0 (per-PRUID queries). Official zip https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/geo/sip-pis/boundary-limites/files-fichiers/lpr_000b21a_e.zip FAILED: HTTP 403 'Security Check' bot challenge page
licence: Open Government Licence - Canada (Statistics Canada Open Licence)
validation_notes: Same 2021 cartographic boundary data served by StatCan's ArcGIS service. Full-resolution requests return HTTP 500 for large provinces, so vertices were generalised server-side (maxAllowableOffset): PE, NS full resolution; NL, QC, ON, SK, AB, BC, YT, NT 10 m; NB, MB, NU 25 m (column gen_tol_m). make_valid applied. Equal-area polygon sum 9,873,487 km2; LANDAREA attribute sum 8,788,703 km2 = official Canada land area 8,788,702.8 (table 98-10-0001). Polygons exceed LANDAREA by 1-20% because the cartographic file includes inland water (largest gaps MB +20%, NT +20%, QC +16%). Against ECCC/NRCan terrestrial baseline areas (CPCAD 2025 statistics) polygons agree within 0.5% for 11 of 13 jurisdictions; exceptions PE +1.3% and ON -8.4% (ON baseline 1,076,395 km2 is larger than the StatCan polygon; cause not verified, possibly Great Lakes waters in the baseline).

Sum of DA population = 36,991,981 = official Canada 2021 total; every province/territory total matches 98-10-0001 exactly. 174 DAs have no population value (table symbol '..' = not available, 178 rows; mostly incompletely enumerated reserves: ON 57, QC 49, BC 28, AB 21, MB 16, SK 3). Representative points are inside each polygon (shapely representative_point). Dissemination blocks not downloaded (DA is sufficient; DB service layer 13 exists if needed).

dataset: Land Cover of Canada 2020 (30 m), CCRS/NRCan (NALCMS)

Classed area 10,597,793 km2 (includes water class 18 = 2,217,457 km2 and some ocean/US edge). FOREST CLASSES USED: 1 temperate/sub-polar needleleaf (2,391,197 km2), 2 sub-polar taiga needleleaf (240,774), 5 temperate/sub-polar broadleaf deciduous (200,340), 6 mixed (568,015); forest total 3,400,326 km2. Classes 8 shrubland and 14 wetland are NOT counted as forest.

dataset: Forest count raster derived from Land Cover 2020 (240 m)
coverage: Canada, 240 m (8x8 aggregation of 30 m), 23,750 x 20,000 px
validation_notes: Band 1 = number of forest pixels (classes 1,2,5,6) among the 64 30 m pixels in each 240 m cell (forest area = value x 900 m2; fraction = value/64); band 2 = number of valid (non-nodata) 30 m pixels; nodata 255 where no valid pixels. Exact area-preserving aggregation (no resampling interpolation). Last partial row/column (<8 px) dropped.

dataset: fma_v2: fire management areas, rebuild 2026-10-21 (MB and QC sub-areas, no Parks Canada layer)
licence: Inherits source licences (MB and SOPFEU web-map files: licence not stated, see mb_qc_subareas/manifest.csv)
validation_notes: fma_all minus the single Manitoba row (fma_id 94), the single Quebec row (92) and the 47 Parks Canada rows (100-146), plus mb_fire_restriction_areas.gpkg (fma_id 1001-1023: 22 MWS fire and travel restriction areas + agricultural-south remainder 97,192 km2) and qc_sopfeu_fire_danger_zones.gpkg (2001-2066: 65 SOPFEU fire danger zones + far-north remainder 519,551 km2). National parks lie inside the province rows. fma_v2_crosswalk.csv maps every old id to new ids: 97 unchanged, 92 and 94 split (share of old area), and each park to the v2 rows it overlaps (overlap km2 on the 20 m simplified copies; marine parks overlap little land).
